title: keybindingspage
summary: MSUI's standalone 1.12-style Key Bindings window captures and displays canonical ALT/CTRL/SHIFT keyboard chords, ignores modifier-only and Super captures, and steals exact chords with the reference red fully-unbound warning or success feedback. Character Specific Key Bindings now creates an isolated GUID-keyed set immediately; destructive uncheck springs back and routes the exact confirmation through the shared rule-positioned StaticPopup before loading the account set and deleting the character set. Remaining UI gaps are mouse/wheel capture and collapsible/search presentation.

openItems.text: No modifier-chord capture: FirstBindableKeyDown binds bare keys only - ALT-/CTRL-/SHIFT-key combinations cannot be bound
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: Capture ignores standalone modifiers, samples held ALT/CTRL/SHIFT with the first non-modifier base key, rejects Super, displays canonical prefix order, and writes BindingChord values into the selected primary/secondary slot. Focused clinical checks pass.

openItems.text: No mouse button (3/4/5) or mouse-wheel binding capture
Character Specific Key Bindings checkbox is cosmetic: _characterSpecificBindings is never read by SaveBindings/LoadBindings - no per-character binding set exists
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: The active set is selected from account keybindings.json or a stable LocalPlayerGuid-keyed character file. Checking immediately persists a copy as the character set. Unchecking springs back, plays the reference checkbox sound and opens the exact shared StaticPopup; acceptance loads the account set before deleting the character file and re-saving the unchanged account set. Focused clinical checks pass.

openItems.text: Stealing a key silently unbinds its previous owner with no KEY_UNBOUND_ERROR-style red warning naming the victim
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: Exact-chord steals identify previous owners before removal. If the victim loses its final key the page displays the victim's binding label in a four-second red 'Function is Now Unbound!' warning; otherwise it displays the reference success feedback.

openItems.text: Focused chord capture, display and conflict source fences pass. Needs owner-run live capture of single and multi-modifier chords, modifier-only/Super refusal, dual-slot steals, visible red victim naming, Cancel rollback and Okay persistence.

Focused persistence-order, GUID filename, checkbox spring-back, source-exact text and shared StaticPopup geometry/lifecycle checks pass. Needs owner-run live acceptance for create/edit/reload, Cancel behavior, confirmed account restoration, character-file deletion, dead-state refusal and two-slot modal seating.
Category headers are plain labels - no collapse/expand sections and no binding search
